results.evidence: The flagged claim (LOTIS-5 safety run-in: 80% ORR, 50% CR, mDOR not reached for CR) is not located verbatim in the restored exhibit excerpt — only the forward-looking-statements boilerplate is visible, which actually references 'the timing of the PFS events and topline data release for LOTIS-5 and the results of the trial' as a forward-looking risk, suggesting the deck does distinguish the run-in from the pivotal readout elsewhere. Without the actual slide text containing the run-in efficacy numbers and their surrounding caveats, I cannot confirm whether the run-in data is being presented as pivotal-equivalent or properly labeled as an uncontrolled safety lead-in. The registry alone (PFS primary, randomized Phase 3, n=440) does not contradict reporting run-in ORR/CR — those are different endpoints from the catalyst primary — so CONFIRMED is not supported on the M evidence shown.

The flagged claim concerns LOTIS-7 style efficacy figures (80% ORR, 50% CR, mDOR not reached for CR) attributed to a 20-patient safety run-in, but the exhibit head shown does not contain the verbatim claim or its surrounding caveats, so I cannot verify whether the presentation labels these as run-in/uncontrolled data or generalizes them to the LOTIS-5 randomized PFS readout. The bound registry confirms LOTIS-5 is a randomized Phase 3 with PFS primary, which is consistent with the first-pass concern, but without the actual slide text disclosing or hiding the run-in framing, masking cannot be confirmed.
